cause_quote: The added `pidNsInode: fs.statSync("/proc/self/ns/pid", { bigint: true }).ino.toString()` made namespace identity unavailable when PRoot returned `ENOENT` while following the link.
user_saw: Gateway startup in a PRoot Ubuntu container failed with `GatewayLockNamespaceError` because the Gateway could not verify its own state ownership.
summary: The fix reads the PID namespace inode from the procfs link text and continues to refuse ownership when the link is unreadable or malformed.
reasoning: The causing commit’s parent admitted an existing Gateway owner using PID and process start time without requiring a namespace probe. The causing diff placed namespace verification ahead of those checks, so PRoot’s `stat` failure turned the Gateway’s own fresh owner into an unknown owner and caused admission to throw, matching the fix PR’s live reproduction.
